Question: What repurchase price does the Boyd 2021 indenture set on a change of control?

message.content: The Boyd 2021 indenture sets the repurchase price on a change of control at "101% of the aggregate principal amount of Notes repurchased plus accrued and unpaid interest and Additional Interest, if any, on the Notes repurchased, to the date of purchase" [boyd2021; Section 4.10; c0492] and similarly states "101% of the principal amount of Notes repurchased plus accrued and unpaid interest and Additional Interest, if any, on the Notes repurchased, to the date of purchase" [boyd2021; Section 12.14; c0917].
